notes: 🔗 Link your devices: ⚙️ Settings › Link devices shows a code. Type it into Link devices on your other device, pick which account stays, and the other one's points move into it — both devices then use the same account. Works for 3 or more accounts too (link them one after another). Also new: 🏰 Tower Defense (solo or team, with its own leaderboards) in the games menu, and the chat's on/off switches are now inside the ⚙️ settings button.
